en.p: Student $\mathrm{A}$ chooses one card at random from 2 cards labeled 1 and 8, and puts the chosen card down on the floor only when the number on it is 8. Student $\mathrm{B}$ chooses one card at random from 6 cards labeled 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and puts the chosen card down on the floor only when the number on it is less than or equal to the natural number $n$.
According to the following rules, let $p$ be the probability that student $\mathrm{A}$ receives a tangerine, and $q$ the probability that student $\mathrm{B}$ receives a tangerine.

box: • If both students put down a card, only the student who put down the card with the larger number receives a tangerine.
• If exactly one student puts down a card, only the student who did **not** put down a card receives a tangerine.
• If neither student puts down a card, neither receives a tangerine.

en.p: When $p=q$, find the value of $24(n+p)$. (Here $n$ is a natural number less than or equal to 7.) [4 points]
